svg.title: The client has a prepregnancy BMI of 22 and a singleton pregnancy. She asks about calorie needs and food safety.
svg.desc: For a client with a normal BMI (18.5-24.9), the recommendation is roughly 340 additional calories per day in the second trimester and 450 in the third, and albacore tuna intake is capped at 6 oz per week because of its mercury content, while swordfish and shark are avoided entirely. 150 calories understates the second-trimester need and 600 overstates it; 3 oz is overly restrictive and 12 oz exceeds the recommended weekly cap for albacore tuna.
